head: e9e35067fc3b419a54d790a71663071455f203f1
result: Zig GPU startup, CLI and real node delivery qualified; broader GPU proving work remains incomplete

delivery.default_demo: Mocks only when strict proving is not requested
delivery.lifecycle_control: One startup/teardown thread; join proof work before shutdown
delivery.shutdown: Clear four proving registrations after successful retirement; retain CPU verifiers
delivery.rejected_shutdown: Keep engine and registrations usable for cleanup/retry
delivery.test_runner: Standalone process with inherited stdio and checked process exit status

reused_qualification.reason: Unchanged source and libraries; CPU FFI expected count corrected from 35 to its actual 32 tests

qualification_notes: The first server-mode Zig FFI pilot reached its 180-second limit while the test process waited on stdin. The standalone-process runner passed the FFI cases; the original pilot remains preserved.
Review found exchange only scans deposits, so it no longer initializes a GPU. The mock transfer demo now rejects strict proving policies.

All CPU FFI tests passed in run-01, but its validator incorrectly expected 35 cases. CPU builds omit three unused GPU-runtime tests and run 32 cases. Run-02 corrects the counter, reruns that check, and finishes the integration scripts.
Thirty-nine passing checks were reused only after verifying unchanged source, library hashes, original manifest and log hashes; original commands and results retain their run-01 provenance.
No Rust proving source changed. The exact five static libraries from qualified checkpoint 9.51 are reused and hash checked.
limitations: The default CLI is still a mock demonstration; GPU proving requires its explicit build option and complete native GPU environment.
The public integration script uses prebuilt libraries during this qualification; its offline Cargo build arguments match the already qualified library feature sets.
Private worker admission, tree/recursive native delivery, quadratic lookups where needed, owned multi-AIR commitments and full-size recursion remain open.
Complete batch proofs remain qualified through four padded tiles, not full 64-tile capacity.
Host orchestration, serialization and independent verification remain CPU work. These correctness checks establish no sustained throughput, multi-GPU, AMD or Metal result.
The pending Apple source still requires its authorized local Mac checkpoint commit; no SSH retrieval was attempted.
